## [18.0.14](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/compare/v18.0.13...v18.0.14) (2026-09-22)


### Bug Fixes

* allow indented lines in setext heading text ([#4095](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4095)) ([7d05530](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/7d05530733fa3f3ec2ed912ff695d05af6d81b8a))

* keep text after empty nested blockquote ([#4101](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4101)) ([1b89557](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/1b89557177fe5a7d5d430fdc76e7c8a7c0adf6d7)), closes [#4098](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4098)
* preserve internal tabs in list item content ([#4086](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4086)) ([e136da7](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/e136da7c7dedcb58af046086005f89350020c416))
* strip whitespace when normalizing link reference labels ([#4091](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4091)) ([c7ee43a](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/c7ee43abecd6a9e024f8bb6818be2da05e5793cb))
* support GFM protocol autolinks ([#4067](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4067)) ([7f7a496](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/7f7a49670c14acc6f11efcb18ecc69d17962477a))
